preconditions.description: T is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == len(B) for A, B in (input().split() for _ in range(T * 2)) if len(A) == len(B))
preconditions.description: For each test case, the lengths of A and B are equal and between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(A in {'0', '1'} for A, B in (input().split() for _ in range(T * 2))) and all(B in {'0', '1'} for A, B in (input().split() for _ in range(T * 2)))
preconditions.description: A and B consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line == str(count) for output_line, count in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [sum(1 for i in range(len(B)) if (A == B[i:] + B[:i]) == '0' * len(A)) for A, B in (input().split() for _ in range(T * 2))]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the count of cyclic permutations of B such that A XOR (cyclic permutation of B) equals a string of all zeros.
